entities.summary: Alexeyevka is a town in Belgorod Oblast, Russia, located on the Tikhaya Sosna River 306 kilometers (190 mi) east of Belgorod. Population: 36,578 (2021 census); 39,026 (2010 census); 39,312 (2002 census); 36,641 (1989 Soviet census). It is located in the historic region of Sloboda Ukraine.
